reviews.text: Mike keeps his word and does what he says. If you ever have any issues or concerns with your dog after they have spent time at Stealth K9 they will re teach you and your dog (even remotely). Very education driven trainers. Just good people.
Thank you for the five star review, Deborah!
Dog learned everything in 4 weeks super happy

Mills is a dog I got from a shelter went to training as he is very large was pulling on the lease would see another dog wanted to go after it.  After training 6 weeks I see a difference in him no pulling the lease, ignoring the other 2 dogs in the home while doing his walking exercise much calmer then he was below he is sitting without moving while the other dog is barking.  Great job with Mills.  We are getting ready to sent the pointer also for training.
Thank you, Estevan!
Thank you, Antionette!

Thank you so much for doing the board and train with Luca. He is still a puppy so he is still hyper. But he walks like a pro and listens when told. I don't think I can walk any other dog now, it would annoy me 😂. Luca walks next to our stroller, next to me, stops when I do, doesn't pull at all. Our 4 year old can walk him. My mom took him for a walk the other day and she said he was amazing.

We are always asking him questions and he responds. Sends great educational videos and explains why you should follow certain things.

I'm sure we will have follow up questions or consultations when he gets a little older. Glad we have that option!!

Cannot recommend highly enough.  Crazy, disobedient, anxious doodle transformed into  a well behaved dog on and off leash. Michael is responsive to questions during and after training.  He was patient with teaching my son how to interact with our dog at home. I was hesitant to make the investment in training but it was worth every penny!!

My dog was very reactive aggressive and after biting a family member I was lucky enough to find stealth K9 ! Michael  did an outstanding job! My dog Mabel had to enter the 8 week training program and after it was all done I had a new dog ! Mabel has completed her course and is doing great but as life goes on there are always questions, not to worry any questions or concerns during this journey are answered straight away by Michael  even after sessions  are completed . Thank you so much Mike you are the best hands down !

10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND Stealth K9 Dog Training.
I have an extremely active and energetic rescue red nose pitbull that is well mannered and great with people. However she was very reactive with dogs and other environmental triggers making it very difficult to go on walks as she would be disobedient and stop listening to commands. She completed 6 weeks board and training and came back a completely different dog. My dog is now off leash trained and she obedient 100% of the time.

The owner, Michael, is an outstanding trainer. He is very responsive with communication and provides education to the pet owners along the way which truly transforms the overall experience.

I just spent 30 minutes talking to Mike on the phone. He gave me all my information on what's the ideal service dog to go buy and bring to him for the 4-week training.
He already gave me so many options that are available to me and that I could do and and I've been diagnosed with generalized anxiety if any other mental disorders.
He was able to keep me calm through it all and I have trouble with communication skills.
He was very patient with me.
So I highly recommend that Anybody needing help getting a dog to be trained COME AND SEE Mike!!!!. He can help you from the beginning to the end. I look so forward to bringing him my golden retriever.
I took my pug there and she came back a different dog, I can definitely tell the difference.  Mr. Michael has been very helpful even after I picked her up, I would definitely recommend him.

I dropped off my Chihuahua mix Finn for a 4 week board and train program to work on obedience and reactivity. I've only had him back for a week and we can already see huge improvements to his listening skills. He reliably heels, sits, and places when we tell him. His reactivity has improved too so we will take more advantage of the unlimited free sessions to work him through that trait.

Mike (the owner) is very knowledgeable and helps me all the time about how to correct some issues Finn may be having. We got videos weekly of Finns progress and Mike sent us an abundance of online recourses to be better dog owners. It was definitely worth the lost time away from our pup and would do it again with Stealth K9.

I couldn’t be happier with the experience I had with Michael and his amazing team. My dog Blackie was with them for 8 weeks, and the progress he’s made is incredible. From the start, the communication and service were top-notch.

I had tried another trainer before, and even they recommended Michael as a behavior modification specialist—and now I see why. They also offer unlimited follow-up sessions after the initial training, which is such a great bonus.

Thank you, Michael and team—I’m so grateful for the work you’ve done with Blackie!

Got my dog back a few days ago and he has been outstanding
Highly recommended

From the first conversation I had with Mike I was already convinced this is where I wanted my Dallas to be. Fully knowledgeable of my gsd breed as well as dogs in general. However, the time and attention he gave to me and my dog were unmatched. While my dog was there he sent me so many videos that would help with my dogs transition once I picked him up.  He had my 5mo gsd in top tier off-leash obedience. I am more than pleased and definitely recommend him. 5 star for sure!

This is my first time getting a dog trained and I’m glad that I chose Stealth K9 Training! Mike and his staff are very professional, helpful, and they did such a great job with my dog. I am seeing another side of her i didn’t know existed. She is calmer and follows my commands. I would definitely use Mike and his staff again and for boarding as well.
Mike is extremely knowledgeable and helpful! I truly appreciate his help with my pup!

Micheal has been great giving me tips via text on potty and trait training my 12 week old miniature poodle. I just got her on Saturday and started chatting with Michael on Monday. It’s now Wednesday and my baby has gotten used to her crate and is potting regularly! He also sent me lots of videos to explain things and provide tips.
Best value for dog boarding I could find. Thanks for taking such good care of my dogs.

These guys at Stealth K9, take the time to really focus on your dog, I took my dog Rocco to Mike and he was totally wild..jumping, scratching, running all over the house like a crazy dog..The dog that I picked up 4 weeks later was amazing..he listens, and is obedient..I cant believe  the transformation...worth every penny..
Susan C
Thank you, Armandina!

After reading reviews and doing research we chose to take our six year old German Shepard to Mike for the 6 week training.  We could not walk our dog in public, he barked at everything that he came in contact with and overall scared people coming to our house.  With him being an adult dog we wondered if it was too late for this type of training.......but we are so glad we did.  He is now a very well behaved dog who doesnt bark, can be walked on a leash without darting off or being distracted by other people, dogs or noise. He obeys all commands and we are very satisfied with the work that Mike and his team did.

Great experience. My dog was having behavioral issues that I initially thought was aggression but was later revealed to be anxiety. He had issues lashing out and lunging at people, but this spot was the reason I was able to get him trained for the better. I did this when he was 1 year old because I felt like he was reaching a critical point and needed some intervention before it got worse. Big bonus for the future unlimited sessions they provide after completing your training because your dog is going to develop and sometimes regress depending on how consistent you are. I also use the boarding because this is the only spot I feel like they will properly handle him. My dog is 75lbs and he's a sweetheart, and I know how to manage him but he will walk over someone who doesn't know how to handle him. I've seen it at other boarding locations. Anyways thanks fellas

Mike and his team at Stealth K9 are fantastic. My Belgian Malinois Petey came home to me yesterday and I’m floored. I just came home from running errands this morning. FOUR different people commented on how well behaved he was. The first pic is Petey in his “down” command at a BBQ restaurant. The second is Petey holding his “place” command while I’m on the couch, and I promise you he’d rather be on the couch. I couldn’t be happier with Stealth. If you love your dog, call them today!

From the consultation and up until the day I picked up Bella. I  give Mike and his staff 10 🌟.
⭐️Very informative
⭐️Great Communication
⭐️Dedication
⭐️Respectful
⭐️Expertise knowledge
⭐️Techniques
⭐️Patience
⭐️Active Listener
⭐️Professional
⭐️Clean
⭐️Organized

I have a husky/ 4wk offleash training. Bella picked up everything fast. I  was so impressed with her training. I  came in 1x for a refresher for myself (not Bella). Once Mike and the staff helped me with commands I started getting results. The videos only show a fraction of what Stealth K9 capabilities are. I will definitely recommend them. 👌  If you think twice you thought wrong. This is the place.

Financially Mike even helped me with finding options that worked with my budget and lifestyle.
I could go on about alot but the proof or prize I should say is the day you get your pup back.

I know I made the best decision.

P.S. Respect Stealth K9's time.
They will update you. I promise
Just remember your dog is not the only dog they have. They have lives too but trust &  know that your pup is in the best hands around the clock. You will worry for nothing 💓 🐕

They say you can’t teach an old dog new tricks, but Mike definitely proves that saying wrong! We took our 6 year old German shepherd that had never been trained on a leash or socialized with other dogs and the result was a completely different dog. My shepherd would over power me if I tried to walk him by pulling and twisting to the point that we were afraid of even attempting to walk him. After mikes 6 week boarding and training program our shepherd now walks by our side on his leash, obeys the sit command, down stay, and place. I can tell him to sit and drop the leash and proceed to walk away from him and he won’t follow. Even in our front yard he stays without being distracted by other dogs or passing cars. Mike also offers life time free sessions to refresh your dog for the remainder of his life.
Excellent service! 100% recommend, My dog was hard and they help him a lot! And Mike always answer my questions!

Stealth K9 exceeded my expectations in every way. From my first conversation with Mike, I knew my puppy was in capable hands. The four-week off-leash program was everything I hoped for and more—Lucky came back disciplined, responsive, and full of confidence.

Mike’s communication and support was outstanding; they kept me updated throughout his stay and made sure I was prepared to continue reinforcing his training at home. I’m beyond satisfied with the results and found the pricing extremely reasonable for the quality and dedication they bring. I highly recommend Stealth K9 to anyone serious about training their dog!

Mike and his staff help pet parents to develop relationships with their dog that that are engaging and rewarding for both you and your dog.  I love what me and my dog can now do together along with all of the  places that we can go and experiences that we can now share SUCCESSFULLY

My Aussie Mix had an unexpectedly long stay  here.  The place is clean and nice.  Mike was quick to correspond with me in a timely manner.  That way I knew how she was doing and when we (kids and I) could visit Maysie.  I worked directly with Mike from beginning to end.  Very kind, patient and knowledgeable.  I recommend this place for training and/or boarding.  Thanks again, Maysie thanks yall too!
Had nice information over the phone great help

My two boys were dog reactive, had zero recall, and were hard to walk because they would pull so much. Michael and his team worked with my dogs for several weeks, and the results were amazing. Heel, off leash recall, calmly sitting next to unknown dogs, they can do it all. Throughout the training, I was getting updates and videos of their progress. Definitely money we’ll spent.

We signed up our dog Cleo for a 6 week training program and she came back so much more obedient and confident. So pleased with these results!! They also watched our 3 dogs while my partner and I were on a vacation and it was smooth & we felt comfortable and safe leaving our dogs with them.

My Belgian Malinois, Hugo, was just a puppy when I enrolled him in both on and off-leash training sessions with Stealth K9. Initially, I was hesitant, naturally concerned about Hugo's adjustment to a new training environment. However, …
Outstanding services, Did more than I asked for I’m very thankful !

This place is truly amazing!!! They literally taught my dog old dog Chance New tricks!! He’s a rescue who had aggression issues, they turned him around in 1 month! He is so well behaved now and they also offer affordable boarding and …
Took my pit bull with aggressive tendencies for the 2 week class and it has really helped. Going to board my dog there every time.
